_comment: Lifecycle for the evidence bucket. Apply with:
Sizing, so the rules read as decisions rather than numbers: four station
clips and four stills per claim is about 50 MB, so five lakh claims is
Rule 1 -- chunk parts under uploads/ are working files. A finished upload
deletes its own parts; this catches the ones whose handset never came
back, a fortnight after the server stopped waiting for them (the server's
own sweep is capture_uploads.expires_at, seven days, extended by activity).
Rule 2 and 3 -- evidence cools but is never deleted here. A claim can be
appealed, and an appeal asks to see the photographs. Nearline after 90
days is roughly half the storage cost with a retrieval fee nobody pays
except at appeal; Coldline after a year is the same bargain again. What
removes evidence is the retention policy in the platform itself
(internal/retention), which erases against a rule somebody signed, not a
